title: Garfield's little pack
description: Little pack allowing you a Vanilla+ gameplay
body:
This modpack is designed to bring a fresh level of depth and realism to base building, featuring immersive mechanics like near-realistic cooking with a skillet, detailed base design, and a variety of unique structures. Every element is carefully chosen to enhance the creativity and authenticity of your builds, making your base feel more alive than ever before.

Rather than just another collection of mods, this pack is crafted to complement and refine your building experience, allowing you to create stunning, functional bases with intricate details.

Join our Discord to share your builds, get support, or provide feedback—we’d love to hear from you!
discord https://discord.gg/fCbM48xNDN
